description: Load this skill whenever the project supports light/dark mode, colour theme switching, high-contrast mode, or responds to prefers-color-scheme. Under no circumstances hard-code colours that break in alternative themes. Absolutely always test colour contrast in both light and dark themes, and respect user OS-level colour preferences via CSS media queries.
